find_news_for_launch.description: Find every story tied to a rocket launch, by its Launch Library 2 launch ID. Reports carry no launch link, so only articles and blog posts are searched.

get_latest_news.description: Get what the Spaceflight News API has published since a given moment, across the collections you pick. Built for a scheduled workflow: the answer carries a 'cursor', and passing that back as 'Newer than' on the next run returns only what has appeared since, with nothing repeated and nothing missed. Left empty it simply returns the newest stories and the cursor to start from.

description: Read spaceflight journalism from the keyless Spaceflight News API by The Space Devs. Search news articles, blog posts and mission reports together or apart, filter by news site, keyword, date or the editors' featured flag, poll for what is new since your last run, and pull every story tied to a specific launch or event by its Launch Library 2 ID. No account or API key is required.
